review_candidates.title: Sales Manager - Digital Grids
review_candidates.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Sales Manager for digital grid solutions, you will drive growth by developing strong relationships with utilities, developers, EPCs, and industrial clients while managing the full sales cycle from opportunity development to order closing. Your role will involve defining winning strategies, conducting market analysis, and ensuring compliance with regulations. You will contribute to the unit’s order intake and gross profit targets by effectively communicating market demands and collaborating with stakeholders. Overall, your focus will be on delivering innovative solutions that meet customer needs in the evolving energy landscape. How You'll Make An Impact Develop new business by identifying and pursuing opportunities with utilities, developers, EPCs, and industrial clients, while building and nurturing strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers. Own the full sales cycle for digital grids—from opportunity development and feasibility studies to bidding, contract negotiation, and order closing—in close coordination with tendering management. Define and execute winning strategies, including project setup, target pricing, Bid/No-Bid decisions, and tailored market and customer acquisition plans for your respective markets. Analyze the market, competitors, and customers, ensuring the quality of market data and trends and keeping Salesforce and the MI tool accurately updated (both qualitative and quantitative). Drive commercial results by contributing to the unit's order intake and gross profit targets, while communicating market demands and developing marketing concepts, business plans, and portfolio launch strategies for Headquarters. Manage stakeholders and ensure compliance, coordinating technical clarifications and win/loss analyses while adhering fully to QA procedures, statutory, regulatory, EHS requirements, and Siemens Compliance and Business Conduct Guidelines. What You Bring A Bachelor's degree (equivalent or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Energy Technology, or a related technical field. Proven sales and business development experience in power systems, grid automation, or digital grid technologies, with a demonstrable track record of consistently overachieving targets. Deep familiarity with grid technologies and the Middle East market, including its customers, decision-making processes, and competitive dynamics. Strong technical knowledge of HV equipment and systems—including GIS/AIS, transformers, substations, and automation, control & protection—paired with a background supporting the integration of automation and digitalization systems. Sharp commercial acumen and contract negotiation skills, enabling you to structure and close profitable deals in high-stakes tendering situations. Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities, combined with the resilience and agility to succeed in a fast-paced, competitive tendering environment. About The Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Opportunities to work with a global team Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

review_candidates.title: Call Center Team Lead
review_candidates.description: Employer Overview A leading composite insurance provider in the UAE, operating in Dokki, Giza, with nearly five decades of excellence, offering comprehensive insurance solutions across health, life, motor, and general lines. The organization operates across all Emirates and Oman, serving over 800,000 clients through a strong network of branches, brokers, bancassurance partners, and digital channels. Renowned for its financial strength and service excellence, it continues to set the benchmark for customer satisfaction and innovation in the regional insurance market. Job Summary The Call Center Team Leader will be responsible for managing day-to-day floor operations, monitoring team performance, and ensuring adherence to service and quality standards. The role will focus on coaching and developing agents, driving customer satisfaction, and ensuring operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Manage daily floor operations, ensuring agent availability, schedule adherence, and effective handling of staff queries according to policies and procedures. Monitor Call Center KPIs and team performance to ensure efficient operations and high customer satisfaction. Coach and develop team members to maintain strong product knowledge and improve call handling, sales, and conversion performance. Ensure team adherence to Call Center guidelines, underwriting guidelines, and operational procedures. Monitor call quality through daily guidance, buddy training, and call monitoring. Set and monitor performance targets related to speed, efficiency, sales, and quality. Prepare and review daily and monthly agent performance reports and provide accurate team and department statistics to management. Organize staffing requirements and shift patterns according to business demand. Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend solutions to enhance operational efficiency. Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and complaints while maintaining strong customer relationships and service standards. Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in a Call Center environment. Previous experience in a team leadership or supervisory capacity is required. Experience in monitoring and managing Call Center KPIs. Strong leadership and people-management skills. Strong coaching and talent-development capabilities. Excellent customer-service orientation. Ability to hold team members accountable for performance. Strong problem-solving and process-improvement mindset. Proactive and results-oriented. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Strong teamwork and collaboration. Confidence and passion for excellence. Ability to work effectively under operational pressure. Knowledge of Call Center service-level and abandoned-call rate metrics. Strong understanding of quality monitoring and quality scores. Customer service and complaint management. Data capture and accuracy monitoring. MIS and performance reporting. Knowledge of Call Center operational procedures and KPIs. Experience with floor management and agent performance monitoring. Excellent computer skills. Ability to prepare and analyze performance reports. Familiarity with Call Center systems, including Genesys . English: Excellent

review_candidates.title: Senior Sales Engineer – Architectural Metal Ceiling & Steel Systems
review_candidates.description: About The Company We are a leading, established manufacturer of metal ceiling systems and galvanized steel sections in Egypt, with over 30 years of experience . Founded by both Egyptian and foreign investors, we have built a reputation for excellence, innovation, and quality. Our products are trusted in landmark projects across the country, from airports and luxury hotels to national stadiums and commercial hubs . Our factory in Sadat City spans 4,000 m² , allowing us to deliver superior solutions that meet international standards, including compliance with EU Standards EN13964 . Why Join Us? Industry Leader: Work for a company that is a cornerstone of the Egyptian building materials sector, with a 30-year track record of success and innovation. Landmark Projects: Contribute to prestigious, high-profile projects that are shaping Egypt's modern infrastructure, including: Cairo International Airport (Terminal 2) Four Seasons Hotels (Sharm El Sheikh & San Stefano) Marriott Hotels (Sharm & Cairo) Amazon Headquarters (CFC) Mall of Arabia & Festival City National Defense Hospital Sports Police & Al Ahly Club Covered Halls Underground Metro Stations The Museum of Illusion Commitment to Quality: Our products are reviewed and tested by the Housing and Building National Research Center and are fully compliant with European standards, ensuring we deliver only the best. Dynamic Environment: We foster a team-oriented culture built on integrity, open communication, and a shared passion for excellence. Your contributions will directly impact our continued growth. Job Purpose We are seeking a highly motivated and technically adept Senior Sales Engineer to drive sales for our premium range of metal ceiling systems, including open cell, tiles, and vertical ceiling solutions , as well as galvanized steel sections. You will act as a technical consultant to architects, consultants, and contractors, helping them realize their vision with our high-quality products. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sales Leadership: Lead the full sales cycle for key accounts within the construction and interior fit-out sectors, from lead generation to closing complex B2B deals. Technical Consultation: Act as a trusted advisor, understanding client project requirements and providing tailored technical solutions using our diverse product range (Open Cell, Tiles, Strips, Vertical Ceiling). Tender & Proposal Management: Prepare and deliver compelling technical and commercial proposals, including technical studies, material specifications, and detailed quantity take-offs. Relationship Building: Cultivate strong, lasting relationships with key decision-makers, including architects, main contractors, and project owners. Market Intelligence: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging project opportunities, providing strategic insights to the management team. Collaboration: Work closely with our engineering and production teams to ensure product solutions are feasible, cost-effective, and aligned with client needs. Requirements & Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Civil, Architectural, or Structural Mechanical Engineering. Experience: 5 to 7 years of proven experience in technical sales or business development within the construction, building materials, or interior finishing industry. Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of construction processes, metal ceiling systems, and the ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings. Sales & Commercial Skills: A demonstrable track record in B2B sales, with excellent negotiation, presentation, and communication skills. Language: Fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken) is mandatory. Personal Attributes: Self-motivated, target-driven, with a collaborative mindset and strong problem-solving abilities. Our Values "We believe that our success depends on our unity and integration as one team, built on integrity and honest, continuous communication." Compensation & Benefits A competitive, performance-based salary package. The opportunity to be part of a 30-year industry success story. A collaborative and supportive work environment. The chance to contribute to Egypt's most prestigious architectural projects.
